title: Topic 4
japanese_text:
Ａ：内定式、「私服でお越しください」って書いてあって。
Ｂ：それ一番困るやつだね。まあＴシャツとか、<u>ラフ</u>すぎなければ、いいんじゃない？
Ａ：<u>無難に</u>黒のワンピースとか？
Ｂ：うん。変に<u>着飾り</u>すぎても浮いちゃうしね。
english_translation:
A: It says “Please wear plain clothes” to attend the ceremony.
B: That's the most annoying part. Well, as long as it's not too rough, like a T-shirt, it'll be fine, I think.
A: A black dress should be pretty safe, right?
B: Yes. If you're too dressed up, you'll look out of place.
